notes.title: Rumble Runners becomes Free To Play
notes.content:
As you read from the title, I have made the decision to turn my game Rumble Runners into a free to play game.

This decision has been made with a heavy heart, since Rumble Runners was my first huge passion project that unfortunately didn't quite get the reach I was hoping for.

I am extremely grateful for the players who supported the early stages and the release of Rumble Runners, and for who were even willing to purchase a copy of the game.

I really enjoyed developing this game, but in hindsight I do realise I might have bit off more than I could chew with a game of this size. I'm a solo developer, a carer to my partner and a father of three neurodivergent children, and during the development of Rumble Runners we were struggling with personal and financial problems that made it hard to commit to developing more content, promoting and maintaining Rumble Runners.

Would I call this all a waste of time? Absolutely not. I have learned many things from developing Rumble Runners. Things I never could imagine I would be able to do , I managed to do; I released a Steam game, with online multiplayer gameplay!. 
And however few players Rumble Runners managed to have, knowing they all enjoyed their time playing is a huge relief to have.

With this decision, I've also got no more plans to further update the game. Plans can change over time if the moment demands it, but as it stands now, I'm not going to be working on any Rumble Runners content.

As I've got no date yet for this change to happen, I will follow up with another announcement for when the change is happening. Expect at least a week from the date of this announcement for it to happen.

Lastly, for any player who decides to give Rumble Runners a go either before or after the date it changes to Free To Play, either alone or with friends, I hope you enjoy what Rumble Runners has to offer!

- Lunatinc

notes.title: Update 1.3.3 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi Y'all!

Rumble Runners 1.3.3 brings some balancing tweaks and a better experience during races.

Gotta go fast!
Have you had runs where you end up being unlucky, just because you're waiting for that pesky speed boost? This update makes it so that you're more likely to get a speed boost power-up the more you don't get it.
That might be a confusing sentence, so let me break it down, haha.
Rumble Runners now counts how many times you picked up a power-up that was not a speed boost. Using this counter it gives you a higher chance of getting a speed boost power-up. It then resets to zero when you receive one. After 4 times of not getting a speed boost, you are 100% certain to get a speed boost.
This should make it a bit easier to catch up to the others.. :)

Impossible 50 slightly more possible.
The hardest mode in Rumble Runners has been made ever so slightly easier by making small tweaks in the Rumbling. For you hard-core players, don't worry, it's still very unforgiving to your mistakes, but now you are less likely to fall by the path just catching up with you, no matter how fast you're going.

Smile for the camera :)
The camera now starts off zoomed out all the way, since that is the preferred zoom with most players since you can see ahead much better.

What's next?
Rumble Runners 1.4 is currently being drafted. It's a much larger major update than 1.3 was, and will be heavily focussed on single-player content. What can you expect?

 solo challenges
 customisable Hub (also for the Multiplayer Lobby!)
 more stats & achievements
 more menu platforms

This list is not exhaustive, as the update is in the pre-designing stage.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi Y'all!

Rumble Runners 1.3.2 comes with a couple changes to path generation and the power-ups!

Priority Spawning
With this new update, you'll have more control with how paths generate with the help of "Priority Spawning".
In the Creator, you can set the priority level per piece or in bulk by setting the creator's Spawn Priority. All pieces placed with that priority setting will spawn in a particular order.

This new feature gives you the opportunity to make the generation flow better when you've placed lots of pieces that would make other pieces spawn slower when you need them placed quicker.

There are 5 different priority levels.

 Priority 1: pieces with this priority will be spawned first.
 Priority 2: they will come after all pieces of Priority 1 have been placed.
 Priority 3: they will come after all pieces of Priority 2 have been placed.
 Priority 4: they will come after all pieces of Priority 3 have been placed.
 Priority 0: they will come after all pieces with priorities have been placed. This is the default priority for pieces.

The end of the path always has Priority 1 assigned to it.
Power-ups always have Priority 0 assigned to it.

Power-up Changes
Thanks to the TikTok poll that was put out a couple days ago, it was clear that some changes were necessary for the power-ups. These changes were made to prepare for the 1.4 Update that will be worked on really soon.


 Power-up duration increased from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
 Power-up respawn time reduced from 5 seconds to 0.5 seconds.
 Power-up pickup range has been doubled.

notes.title: Update 1.3; Enormous Paths, is now Live!
notes.content:
Hi Y'all!
I'm happy to announce the biggest update to Rumble Runners as of yet:
Version 1,3; Enormous Paths, is now available for downloading!

So, what's new?
I'm glad you asked!

Creator Tags
From now on, any path you make will be linked to your Steam Account!
All your paths will show under "My Paths" in the Path Creator and when setting up Paths for races.
Now it's easier to show off which paths are created by you,
[strike]It would be even greater if path sharing was a thing already..[/strike]
Please make sure you're logged into Steam before making paths.

Easier Controls in the Path Creator
Have you gotten used to the clunky controls from the Path Creator?
Well, I'm sorry to say [strike]not really to be honest[/strike] the controls are much different now!
Different in a good sense, though!
Forward now means forward from the way you're looking and not in one direction only!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/0e48b751888679e0c0ef6380a550c87191af042d.gif
The gizmos that used to indicate which way you'd press are gone, because they've been made redundant. Doesn't it also just look much cleaner too?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/8567383e26eda4db82f2047a5a6729bcfd30cdcf.gif
Making this slope for example, is much easier now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/8843d609ff7d52fcae02d00edc151e7d951fb6c0.gif
Rotating a piece is much clearer too; three rings indicate which axis you would rotate over. It still uses the world rotations and does not consider the way you look at the piece, because that would otherwise make it really hard to line pieces up.

Coloured Pieces
Yes, your pieces would already have colours assigned to them before, but this time you have more control over which piece has which colour!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/e5653e4b6c1eba3d6dbaa07520ac1d181278452f.gif
This will make sure the piece is always that colour when its path generates.
Now you can make very particular paths, like "pixel-art"... or "path-art" which would be more accurate of a description.

Enormous Path Creator
To make enormous paths...
The size of the bounds in the Path Creator are now much wider and longer, giving you the chance to go enormous with your creations!
You can now build in a 21x21x41 area, which makes it about three times larger than before!

Before this update, you could only place 50 pieces per path. Pah! Why stifle creativity like that?!
So I took the liberty to increase that cap? How much?
100? 200? Nope.
There is no cap anymore.
You read that right! The only thing that would stop you now is if it doesn't fit anymore.
[strike]I'm pretty sure that if you still don't have enough room, you also do not like your PC at all, how is that poor thing coping with all those pieces to consider.[/strike]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/f6217e369a0a9e7de475e4d4fdafe54c5991bd0c.gif
This is one example of how enormous things can get!

The only limit is your imagination!
and the aforementioned size of the creator...
So what will you make next?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/b54bbaed4467fe7ac70527c3c248836800f9ed9e.gif

For a more extensive list of changes made with this update, you can read the changelog.

Changelog:

 Added Creator Tag to Paths.
 P.O.V. based movement in Path Creator.
 P.O.V based Grid movement in Path Creator.
 Cleaner gizmos for rotation.
 No more move gizmos for movement.
 New key-bindings for keyboard & mouse and gamepads.
 Specific colours for pieces.
 Cleaner UI for colour and shape selection.
 Faster move speed in the creator.
 Decreased test path count to 1.
 Grid steps now display in meters.
 Use d-pad to zoom for gamepads (Creator and Golem).
 Path drafts are now remembered after exiting the game.
 Auto-save feature added to Path Creator (every 1 minute).
 Fixed a multiplayer issue where games don't end after end has been reached.
 Rumble effect visible again for joined players.
 Separated list of paths per creator.


That's it for the Enormous Paths Update!
I hope you'll enjoy your extended creative freedom!

Let's Get Ready To Rumble - Run!
- The Game Master.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.2 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi y'all!
What's changed with this Patch?
You will no longer randomly crash out of Multiplayer games!
This patch was very difficult to get right, as the bug this patch fixes was not consistent.
The issue lies with the network latency, or "Ping", where a high Ping would cause problems with loading things.

Sometimes you might experience your Golem's skin not loading in properly. This is due to a high ping and you might then find that some game events don't get triggered right.

Due to a bug within a plugin that Rumble Runners uses; Advanced Steam Sessions, you might've noticed that the Ping is always stuck at 9,999, even when the connection is very strong. Because of that, I've temporarily disabled the Ping display when you look for Parties. This might make players join Parties where they can't get a strong connection with and for that inconvenience I am very sorry.
I am keeping my eyes peeled for a solution, but since Rumble Runners is now very stable, this patch was okay to get released.

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Rumble Runners v1.1 Update
notes.content:
What's new in Rumble Runners v1.1
Graphics Settings
In this update there's now an option to set Graphics Settings within the game. This feature allows players with lower-end specs on their PC to play Rumble Runners with much more ease.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/6bd9a53af51831d47271b079dd111d9987424451.png
"Lowest" is the least costly setting for each type of setting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/0a71745bdeea041869dee3aadf60b2f7ad7ea95e.png
"Best" is the most costly setting for each type of setting.

The settings range from Lowest > Low > Normal > High > Best.

When you press "Recommended", Rumble Runners will pick settings that it recommends for your PC by benchmarking. This will normally only take a couple seconds.

There's also a "Default" button that lets you set the settings to their default value.

Press "Apply" to apply the settings.

New look for the path pieces.
The Path Pieces and the Section Pieces have gone through a visual overhaul. After extensive research and feedback from players, I've found that the wireframe look in previous versions had mixed experiences (some loved it, some found it too confusing) and the wireframes added extra costs on performance.

I've redesigned all the pieces to have less lines and made the edges thicker.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/0e1d3ec9c89edaa578c6cde3a944a3fecd0215e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/cab8ce864aede168978118b898285175d78e2095.png

Info Pop-ups
More info pop-ups have been added to the settings, to explain certain settings that might not be self-explanatory.

That's it!
This wraps up the v1.1 update for Rumble Runners. This update was focussed on accessibility for most players.

What do you think of this update? Feel free to share your feedback and enjoy the improved Rumble Runners!

- The Game Master

notes.title: Improved Path Creator
notes.content:
What has changed?
So for the full release planned later this month, The Section Creator has been changed in some ways, making it much easier to create paths.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/86403cc9b5f23042b1bfe9153b24998d53d85573.png
The UI has been tidied up by a lot! There is no longer a "Creator Mode" you have to toggle through, since everything is now compact and easy to access! On the left you can see all the stuff you can do, and on the right is some info on your path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/d659ee5a809932470f241860c6a690df3a23379e.png
Instead of having to toggle between path shapes, you can now open a menu which displays all the pieces you can place. End Pieces and Powerup Crystals are also in this list, and you can select them simply by pressing them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/c170a54ae08b60d9a0400dc6106a17a4d9256736.png
Rotating a piece is very simple now. You'll have to hold the "Rotate" button, which is either Left Shift or the Left Shoulder Button. When you let go, it goes back into moving the piece.

You can also select a grid step size that the creator will stick to, meaning you can make nicely aligned paths.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/94f754b9748a076b5929dd9960ce500f651c2a26.png
Hover over a piece and select "Edit Piece" to open the Edit Menu for that piece. You can set the Launch Strength here, turning it into a Launch Pad!

Once you've placed all the pieces and the Path is practically complete, you take it for a test run per usual!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/7334aa8c708b29a0f236adcebc901f35b30dd8b4.png
Remember, this is a required step in order to save your creation! You need to guarantee that your path can actually be completed! We wouldn't want to get players stuck now, do we?

And that's it for this smaller update. The next update will be aimed to add a whole lot more default paths, which will be the real paths to be used by full release!

- The Game Master

notes.content:
Major Update 4 is out!
Rumble Runners has undergone some massive overhauls in visuals and audio! With this latest update, Rumble Runners has reached a point where a full release is imminent!

So what's new?
I'm glad you asked!

New Main Hub
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/d6677681074ba1afd64593c9d8402458f78d653b.png
The Main Hub has been remade to fit all the menu platforms properly. It's now a 5-point-star shape and each platform has its own point.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/ec014194536218bed384ad65e7540d76cc767ac8.png
Furthermore, it will be a lot easier to tell which platform is which with the new holograms spelling out the platform's menu type! There's also a 3D-hologram icon for each menu to show their purpose if you can't wait for the letters to come 'round :p

More Animations!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/41627ac8bb639c154ab9ea2c415cc878b32a5248.png
Your Golem will respond when you select a new part or colour in the Customiser. The animations also let you see your Golem in action, so that you can decide if you like your drip from other points of view!

Animations now also have sounds playing when the Golem does something. Footsteps, jumping and more sounds have been added, bringing more life to your rocky friend!

Improved HUD In-Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/92ea8708e1f88d30591a5d2d929ff0907ad27c3e.png
You'll have a clearer overview with what's going on in the UI during a run.
The Power Meters have been redesigned and put around the MiniMap. They work exactly the same as they did before, but with a cleaner look and put more out of the way. There's also a pop-up that comes up when you pick up a power-up crystal that tells you which power-up you got!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/2d706c0bc1047eb989585184f7b5f9e3faeb7f2f.png

New look for Stardust
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/cbc685946b4bc92dd4021a4139f288e3fcf7d7a0.png
The Stardust clumps you can pick up and use as currency now look very different. They now look the same as their icon and in the Shop Hologram from the Main Hub and are also easier to grab now too!

A Music Player!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/6e8e47dc37e6930d2156baa46a4c7d09cbd09af8.png
Tired of the same track with each race? You're in luck, because now you can choose one of 34 total music tracks to listen and vibe to! You can change music during a run with a simple press of a button. There are various genres and moods between the available music tracks, so there should be less repetition now!

*Disclaimer*
The Game Master and Lunatinc do not own any of the music tracks that are being used in-game. All music has been created by TeknoAXE and falls under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

More Game Master babble!
I've undergone some vocal training, practised *enunciation* and practised singing, all to give you a much better appraisal to your gaming skill. I'll leave you remarks on everything you do because I know you seek my validation!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/6e8e47dc37e6930d2156baa46a4c7d09cbd09af8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/eb82872cbab5521b82690f8e5af0abc431d10203.png

I even prepared an intro to Rumble Runners that I'm very happy and proud of, and I am eager to show you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/72f5c94564f4e98069ebf90d3b7ab7c1ae706ff4.png
[strike]Please don't skip it though I practised hard. :([/strike]

Lots of Bugfixes
Some mishaps since the last Update have also been ironed out, luckily!

 You can now create Paths in the Path Creator (Previously named Section Creator) again!
 The OOB Camera now works again, so you can enjoy seeing yourself tumble to your [strike]doom[/strike] next round of Rumble Running!
 The whole Path will now start to Rumble, and is much bandwidth-friendlier than ever!
 Yellow colours are back in the Customiser after spotting too much green in the colour picker!
 The Dialogue box is no longer in the way of the menu pages and you can click on all the buttons easily again.
 The pause menu will no longer get in the way and "get stuck" on screen!

There's a lot of under-the-bonnet changes that won't show, but should improve the game somewhat!

So what's next?
For Major Update 5, Steam will be integrated completely into Rumble Runners. Think of achievements, a leader board for the Infinite Runs and more! Also there will be way more content to the paths and a lot more Golem Parts to pick from. This means that a Full Release is imminent!
It's planned for the 23rd of May!

A complete demo will also be derived from Major Update 4, which will be available relatively soon-ish!
If you want to stay notified you can do that by following Lunatinc's Social Media and wishlisting Rumble Runners!

That's it for this update!
Let's get ready to Rumble... RUN!
- The Game Master

notes.title: Major Update 3: Infinity Run, is finally here!
notes.content:
Infinite Mode is here!
A new mode has come to Rumble Runners, called "Infinite Mode"!
Other than your skill, there is virtually no end to each round in this endless game mode.
It's also available online, where you race to be the last Golem standing!

You can set the Game Mode before you start the race in the menus where you start a game. Only the Host can do this in the Lobby!

Get more chances on finishing a game!
In all previous versions of Rumble Runners, it was a one-strike-you're-out mentality.
However, in this update you can set a limit of retries. When you fall off, it will cost you one retry!
The Game Master can't rematerialize you forever, eh!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/9ed508aa2ae076f1afe6e8f9636d5bb3446b2681.gif

A New Move: the Meteor Stomp!
To celebrate a new race mode, The Game Master has taught their Golems a new move dubbed the Meteor Stomp.
This move will forcefully bring the Golem down, which could be very useful in long drops!
You could also figure out some new techniques and skills to get ahead of the competition!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/45d14383b274b90ab927ddd7403998506db7ead1.gif 

Another New Move: Edge Grabbing!
You'd have to remind Golems of the simplest things sometimes; they have hands! Use them to grab a nearby edge and hang from them to save yourself!
A simple flip after, and you're back in the race!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/186670a46c6dd16a1a31d544b7f3c869915e8db2.gif

Positions
A new feature that's also been added is positions. You can get in 1st place by winning, all the way down to 8th place. Each game mode in Rumble Runners has a different way to determine who won!

Bugfixes & smaller features
There have been quite some performance and little extra things added with this update too.
You can now find a overview of all the key bindings in the control settings menu.
Some small UI changes have also taken place in several menus, making them a tad easier to navigate. There was an issue where you couldn't click on certain buttons, but that's been fixed.

We hope you're just as excited for this big update as we are!
Get ready to Rumble (Run)!
- The Game Master

notes.title: "Under the Hood" changes
notes.content:
A quick patch to fix and optimise some underlying code.
Also fixed the bug where the Music settings don't affect the Section Creator's music.
Added "Settings" to Section Creator's menu as well, so you can set the music and controls there too.

notes.title: Major Update 2
notes.content:
Major Update 2
The next big update has come to Rumble Runners! This update brings a flashy new UI for all the menus, which are now easier to use and also fully compatible with a game controller.

But that is just the tip of the iceberg..

New customisation possibilities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/f7594bbb09e7454d4f62e2cdd97ebd55b8e52e0a.gif
Every Golem part can now have their own colours, different from the other parts!
You used to only be able to set three colours for all the Golem parts, but now your hands, feet, torso and head can have different colours from each other. This is even the case for the hands and feet; they can be different colours from each other too, or even a different part altogether!

This will give you tons more creative freedom, so have fun customising your Golem!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/aa12ee858513a785f2e47cb7dd13e661389cecf4.png
The buttons to select your body parts have gotten a fresher look as well, making it even clearer which button sets which body part!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/ed869cc66d6ee97260196ea3edf37e1755bcf5cf.png
The clunky sliders from the previous versions have been replaced by a grid with 216 different colours!
You can set which colour is being set by choosing Primary, Secondary and Accent colours.
That gives you 216x216x216 = 10 million different colour combinations! 
Your customisations would be incredibly unique now!

You can view your Golem from all sides by rotating them around in the Golem Customiser to have a clearer picture of what you're selecting!

The shop has a visual upgrade too
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/5c1a578cbfc3040c7404541c3a46a049d530c9d9.png
The shop is a lot more user-friendly now. You can select a category and see a drop-down list of all the available parts to purchase with Stardust. You'll also see the price before you click on a part.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/fba3b1718ecf4596becda00743a084570a664dc4.png
When you click on a part, you can preview it on your Golem before you decide to buy it. You'll be able to rotate your Golem as well to preview it from all angles.
If you've decided you like the part, you can click "Buy Part", but make sure you have enough Stardust!

Custom Races & Multiplayer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/68fc0f920a151fdd73b2216c03cbbc557a332c39.png
Custom Races & Multiplayer Races are much easier to set now too! Before you start a game you can set the Game Settings, where you set the difficulty, the amount of paths (which are now 5 to 50, with an interval of 5 between) and which paths you want to use.

Setting the paths to use has been moved from the Section Creator to the Game Settings, as that would be more natural and expected so you can adjust your game settings all in one place.
You can do this in the Lobby of your Party as well (as long as you are the Host).
Any player that's connected to your Party can also see the changes you're making, so they can tell you if they like what you did. But even if they didn't, you're the Host! Just don't be too cruel and make it fun for everyone, eh! ;)

The Main Menu is just one button away!
Do you remember the time when you had to walk to settings to set basic necessities. Or even to exit the game? Yeah, that was awful, but not to worry, press "Enter" (or Start) to open a new menu with everything available straight away.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/4a89d62d12adc79bb32b122e2c5b973d68df68cd.png
You can access the Settings here, where you can set the audio volume.

Newly added to the Settings is the Control Settings.
Here you can set how sensitive your controller and mouse are, and if you want to invert the inputs as well.
Now you can set your controls to your play-style!

other changes & Bugfixes:

 Naming a path section now comes with a check if the name has already been used.
 You can cancel inputting a name at any time
 Confirm choices in Custom Races and Multiplayer menus (leaving, starting etc.)
 Texture changes to several Golem Parts
 Added 'Extreme' Difficulty
 Added 'Impossible' Difficulty (even I struggle with it and I'm the developer!)
 General optimisations in performance


That's it for this update!
If you want to know what's planned for Major Update #3, make sure to follow Lunatinc on their Social Media: Lunatinc's Social Media

Enjoy!
- The Game Master

notes.title: Loading Path Patch
notes.content:
A quick fix for the path loading issue!
Players who have updated to the newer version would see no paths generating as the loading code has been altered so that they are no longer compatible.
This means that, unfortunately, you will have to reset to the new default paths and lose your previous creations to this point.

How do I reset?
It's quite simple to reset your paths.
[olist]
 Go to the Section Creator.
 Go to Load Path and confirm to continue.
 Below, next to the Go Back button is a new button called Reset Paths.
 Click on Reset Paths and confirm your action.
 Your paths have been reset!
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/a3922e2b0d5fbab8616f9a76837feb4593260417.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/4e8e159703001d327273fa7e3c2114be1e18af9b.jpg

Sorry for the inconvenience this has caused!
Many thanks
- The Game Master

notes.title: New Year; New Updates
notes.content:
Hello Rumblers!

For the last couple months I've worked hard to bring many improvements to Rumble Runners and this is the first of the couple major updates coming to Rumble Runners!

The return of the Section Creator!
As you might have seen since the last update, the Section Creator was unavailable. This was because the previous update brought too many changes to the Section Creator and broke it, but alas, the new and improved Section Creator is now back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/862a44a256058a25689f07b674d4bb7c516a64d4.png
This Section Creator is a lot more intuitive with an index on both sides, showing you what you could do.
It is now also completely compatible with any of your game controllers, which wasn't the case before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/276b2704e5a9b2cd3b1f03bc094ee928262f7829.png
The new menu has lots of extra functionalities which lets you load, test and clear your paths. The Creator will also remember your latest draft path (from the same session) so if you need to adjust something quickly, it can be done now!

Visual Updates!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/8f70bbfd56d8274ee40771e2dd34d839f6ef9483.png
A darker, more atmospheric deep space and wireframe glowing path pieces are some of the new eye-candy that has been added to Rumble Runners! 

Section End pieces have also been changed to fit in nicer with wider paths, and now come with assisting chevrons showing you in which direction the next paths will be generated in!

Directional Launchpads!
In the Section Creator, you can rotate any piece in any direction. This also applies to the launch pads, which will launch you into the direction they're tilting to! You can tell the launch strength and the direction by the star dust trail coming from the launch pads!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40668992/637388a4b049528e203fa96831da68295383c69a.png

Other changes
Some other changes have been made too:

 Improved mobility and control for the players.
 Power-ups can now be placed separately from the path pieces.
 You can no longer tell what power-up you will get; all power-ups look the same now.
 The Section Creator comes with visible boundaries so you can see how far you can build out.


That's it for now!
As mentioned, this is only one of the major updates that have come to Rumble Runners. If you want to know what's next, you can contact me through my social media! Keep an eye out for bigger updates coming soon (eventually! haha!)

- The Game Master

notes.title: Performance & Bug fixes
notes.content:
This build of Rumble Runners comes with a lot of optimisations and bug fixes that were in the last build version.

Fixes:
- Launchpads and Powerup platforms now show their particles
- Reduced latency issues
- End of Game no longer triggered when Host is out of game (and joined players are still in a match)
- Powerup durations now show properly in the powerup bars
- Countdown not showing for connected players
- Powerups not spawning when standing still in recharging powerups

These fixes should allow for a much better playing experience =)
 Thank you for your patience!

- Lunatinc

notes.title: New Golems available in the Stardust Shop
notes.content:
The new Golem Parts are here!
The Gnome, the Alt 1 and the Axolotl have come to Rumble Runners! These were added after people on social media have suggested what golem parts should be available to customise yourself with, so many thanks to all who made their suggestions!

Other changes
There are some bugfixes when it comes to the menus. The shop works properly with the gamepad now, as it would keep exiting out of it when trying to buy a golem part.

The OOB (Out Of Bounds) and Game Over message are now quicker, so you can keep the flow going a lot better :)

Launchpads are now distinguishable from regular path pieces, so they won't leave you 10 feet in the air by surprise anymore.

Powerups now have particle animations to show them being regenerated.

Do you have an idea for a Golem design?
You can follow me on social media to suggest a design! Simply go to your preferred social media platform Lunatinc is on and leave a message. You don't have to sketch anything per se, but it could help with the design process!

Lunatinc's Social Media

What's next?
Rumble Runners is undergoing some maintenance regarding the multiplayer aspect. I'm ensuring that the connections are more stable and the game waits nicely for others to be ready first. I will also then introduce a round system, where you need to win a set amount of rounds to win a competition, which will give you nice extras!
A chat system is also being worked on, so you can say hi to anyone anytime when they're in your party!

notes.title: The Shop Update!
notes.content:
Ka-Ching!
Grab your Stardust and head over to the newly opened shop to get yourself some new Golem parts. Nico and Lilano parts are now available in the shop with more soon to be added!

Visual representation in the Golem Customiser
The Golem Customiser has received a small visual update, so that you can see the body parts before you put them on. It's much easier to see what the parts look like than to remember all the names, isn't it?

Performance boosts
The features in Rumble Runners have undergone some major reworking under the hood, but the gameplay is practically the same. This will help the loading in the Multiplayer somewhat, but Multiplayer will still undergo some extra special maintenance in the near future to optimise gameplay.

What is next?
The next update will populate the Shop a lot more with many more parts to pick from.
My suggestion; pick up Stardust before the next update drops so you can buy your new favourite parts straight away!

There's more?
If you keep your eye on Lunatinc's social media, you can help with the designs of the new Golem Parts and even make your own suggestions!
Lunatinc Social Media

Get ready to Rumble again!
- The Game Master

notes.title: Rumble Runners improvement updates
notes.content:
Last Day of July Update
Hey everyone!
Some stuff has been updated in Rumble Runners!

Changelog

 Latency optimizations
 Reduced Star Fragment Boost particles
 Altered player movement: Jumps are less floaty, faster running, faster animations
 Fixed bug where naming a party would bug out the menu screen
 Fixed bug where you randomly walk after exiting a menu screen
 Zooming when moving in the Section Creator using a game pad


That's all for this update. I hope it helps improve your gaming experience!

What's next?
For the next big update, which will be Rumble Runners v1.1, the shop will be implemented.
Along with the shop, you'll be able to use the Stardust you have picked up and buy yourself more Golem Parts!

Let's get ready to Rumble Run!
- The Game Master

notes.title: Multiplayer Fixed!
notes.content:
Multiplayer is fixed
Albeit not optimal, you can now finally properly play with other players anywhere!
There are still some small issues where you could get stuck in the Lobby floor, but I'm looking into a fix for that in the near future.

I hope you've honed your skills in Singleplayer and build challenging Sections in the meantime and are ready to race others and start testing who truly is the best runner in the Universe!

- The Game Master

notes.title: Rumble Runners is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Rumble Runners is now playable!
At last, you can now play Rumble Runners!

Try the Random Track Generation 
Be steady on your toes, but don't slack either because the Track will Rumble and fall behind you. If you fall, you'll go OOB {Out Of Bounds}. You only get one chance!

Pick up Star Fragments
Along the Track you will find power-ups, called Star Fragments. They will help you in your run, but don't overshoot your landings!

Stardust is everywhere
The material that you, I and the track are built out of is also the currency!
Save up Stardust now for when the shop's open!

Multiplayer
Rumble Runners is a Multiplayer game. Get your friends to get a copy, form parties and see who of you is the best runner in the universe... of your party!
Parties are capped at 8 players, at least for now!

Get involved with the future of Rumble Runners
If you come across something you want to talk about, you can follow me on any of my social media!
There is a list of links you can find on my flow page.

Lunatinc on Social Media & More! 

Most of all, have fun!

- The Game Master
